# A customer's USD prepayment, then its refund.
#
# The prepayment arrives as USD in the bank against a credit on the
# receivable, joined to the customer's own lot. The refund sends it back: a
# debit on that same receivable, which is the *normal* direction for a
# receivable and yet is money leaving the book.
#
# What this fixture produces: two cost bases, each at 1.37 (Q-054). The bank's
# 100.00 USD is an asset cost basis of the dollars held. The credit takes the
# receivable below zero, and is a liability cost basis of the 100.00 owed
# back to the customer.
#
# The refund pays the customer back out of the bank: dollars held leave, and
# what was owed goes. So it consumes both cost bases, and states each: the
# bank split the bank's, and the receivable split the credit's. Both leave
# at the 1.37 they were taken on at, and no gain is realized. The book ends
# holding and owing nothing, and both cost bases have 0.00 left.
#
# What separates a refund from an invoice posting: a posting sits in the lot
# its invoice owns, a refund settles an owner lot that no invoice owns.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

2026-01-15 * "Customer prepays 100 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0100"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "137.00"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0101"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-137.00"
		lot_owner: "customer:C-US"

2026-02-01 * "Refund the customer's USD prepayment"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "137.00"
		lot_owner: "customer:C-US"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0101"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-137.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0100"
